pages.title: Fresh from the farm · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Saturday morning at a farmers market in Portland. Colorful stands line the street under white tents. The smell of fruit and fresh bread fills the air. Leo walks with a cloth bag and two excited kids. At a stand with red crates, a farmer waves. Her name is Rosa.
“Welcome back! I remember you.” says Rosa. “Hi, Rosa! Last Saturday, I bought strawberries here.” says Leo. “Yes, and you loved them, right?” says Rosa.
